question: How many days a week can I work from home?
reference: One day a week (Wednesday or Thursday) with 0-3 years of service, two days a week after 3 years.
answer: Employees with 0 – 3 years of service can work from home one day per week, while those with 3 or more years of service can work from home two days per week [1].

question: How much does the company pay toward my commute if I come to the office three days a week?
reference: $75 per month (2-3 office days a week); the archived 2025 handbook still says a flat $132.
answer: If you commute to the office 2–3 days per week, the company contributes $75 per month toward your commute [1, 2]. This applies only if you are U.S.-based and assigned to and commute to the New York office at least two days per week [3, 4].

question: How long is the probation period for a new hire?
reference: 3 months; 1 month for Affordable Housing and Property Tax Analysts.
answer: The standard adaptation (probation) period for a new hire is 3 months, but for Affordable Housing and Property Tax Analysts it is 1 month [1, 2].

question: What should the background of my profile picture look like?
reference: A solid neutral background, gray is preferred.
answer: The background of your profile picture must be solid and neutral, with gray being preferred [1].

question: What time does the Costa Rica team start and finish the workday?
reference: 7:00 am to 4:00 pm Costa Rica time, with a 1-hour lunch break.
answer: The standard working hours for the Costa Rica team are 7.00 am – 4.00 pm Costa Rica Time, with a 1 hour lunch break [1].

question: On which days are the advanced English classes held?
reference: The C1-C2 group meets on Monday and Wednesday, 10:00-11:00 Kyiv time.
answer: Advanced (C1–C2) English classes are held on Monday & Wednesday [1]. Schedules may be adjusted based on participation and business needs [1].

question: What rate am I paid for hours beyond 40 in a week?
reference: Non-exempt employees get 1.5 times their normal hourly wage for hours over 40 in a workweek.
answer: Any non-exempt employee who works overtime will be compensated at the rate of one and one-half times (1.5) their normal hourly wage for all time worked in excess of 40 hours each week [1].

question: How many hours of paid sick time do I get each year in New York?
reference: 40 hours of paid safe and sick time, granted at the start of each calendar year.
answer: Employees receive a grant of 40 hours of safe and sick time at the start of each calendar year [1]. Employees may not use more than 40 hours of safe and sick time in any calendar year [2]. Unused time may be carried over to the following year, but usage is still capped at 40 hours per year [3].

question: How often is pay reviewed for the Affordable Housing Processing Team?
reference: Every 6 months; the hiring manager tracks the cycle and starts the review.
answer: For employees in the Affordable Housing Processing Team, salary reviews are conducted every 6 months [1]. The Hiring Manager tracks each employee's 6-month review cycle and initiates the review requests on time [1].
cited: ai_course/HR-Salary Review Process via BambooHR_ A Structured Overview-071126-121239.pdf#9

question: How many floating holidays do employees on the EU team get?
reference: Five floating holidays per calendar year.
answer: Employees on the EU team get five (5) Floating Holidays per calendar year [1].

question: How much vacation do US employees accrue per year during their first three years?
reference: 1.77 hours a week, 92 hours (11.5 days) a year for full-time employees.
answer: US employees in their first three years are shown two different amounts. The policy update effective 2026-01-01 gives 1.77 hours weekly, which is 11.5 days per year [1]. The same-dated update gives 80 hours (10 days) per year [2]. The older handbook lists 92 hours (11.5 days) per year [3]. Please confirm the correct figure with HR.

question: How many days of annual leave do employees in Ukraine have?
reference: 24 calendar days of paid annual leave a year.
answer: Employees in Ukraine are eligible for twenty-four (24) calendar days of paid annual leave [1]. The paid time off overview for the EU team (full-time) likewise lists 24 days of vacation, accrued on a calendar year [2].

reference: PFL-DC-120 is the Paid Family Leave Discrimination Complaint filed with the Workers' Compensation Board.
answer: Form PFL-DC-120 is the Paid Family Leave Discrimination Complaint form. An employee uses it to file a PFL discrimination complaint with the Workers' Compensation Board if the Company does not comply with a reinstatement request within 30 days [1].

question: Скільки днів щорічної відпустки мають працівники в Україні?
reference: 24 календарні дні оплачуваної щорічної відпустки.

question: Скільки триває випробувальний термін для нового працівника?
reference: 3 місяці; для Affordable Housing і Property Tax Analysts — 1 місяць.
answer: Стандартний випробувальний термін для нових працівників становить 3 місяці [1, 2]. Для аналітиків з доступного житла (Affordable Housing) та аналітиків з податку на майно (Property Tax Analysts) він становить 1 місяць [1, 2].

question: With how many days' notice can either party terminate a contractor agreement?
reference: Either party may terminate for any reason with 7 days' prior written notice.
answer: Either party may terminate the agreement for any reason upon 7 (seven) days' prior written notice to the other party [1]. If a party has materially breached an obligation and the breach remains uncured for 30 days after written notice, the other party may also terminate [1].

question: Do we offer company benefits to interns?
reference: No. A temporary intern is not eligible for Company benefits; interns are paid hourly, weekly, and are eligible for overtime.
answer: As a temporary intern, you will not be eligible for Company benefits [1].

question: I joined three months ago. Can I already work from home?
reference: Yes, one day a week (Wednesday or Thursday); the archived 2025 handbook started remote days only after 1 year.

It says nothing about employees with under 1 year, so based on these sources you are not shown as eligible yet [1]. This rule applies to USA employees only, so please ask HR to confirm for your location.

question: I joined three months ago. Can I already work from home?
reference: Yes, one day a week (Wednesday or Thursday); the archived 2025 handbook started remote days only after 1 year.

With three months of service you do not yet meet the minimum, and the extra remote days also require more than 1 year of service [1].

question: Скільки днів на тиждень можна працювати з дому?
